title: Tasty Sticky Chicken Meatballs Recipe
content:
Sticky chicken meatballs recipe is one of my favorite. This hardly takes a few minutes to cook. The cool thing about this recipe is you can add whatever spices and herbs you wish in the meatballs. Sticky chicken meatballs recipe is easy to customize as per your taste.

The sauce coating the meatballs is sweet and garlicky. You could add some chili flakes in them if you want some kick. But when making for kids, it is best to avoid it so that they can enjoy it too.

 

Here are few tips for getting perfect, tender and juicy chicken meatballs.

 

1) Add bread soaked in some milk for adding moisture.

2) Don't over mix the meatballs.

3) Don't over fry the meatballs.

4) You could add some water into the meatballs mixture to make it juicy.

5) Grind half chicken breast and half chicken thighs for added moisture.

6) Adding onions and peppers will add moistness to the meatballs.

 

I hope you will love this recipe and let me know if you try it.

Sticky Chicken Meatballs Recipe

 

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 30 mins

Total time: 40 mins

 

Recipe type: Appetizer

Cuisine: Chinese

Serves: 3 servings

 

Ingredients

For Meatballs :

Minced Chicken - 250 grams

Chilli Powder - ½ teaspoon

Pepper Powder - ½ teaspoon

Coriander Leaves - 2 tablespoons finely chopped

Green Chilli - 1 teaspoon finely chopped

Parmesan Cheese - ½ cup grated

Bread - 1 slice

Milk - 4 tablespoons

Salt to taste

Italian Seasoning - 1 teaspoon

 

FOR SAUCE:

Oil - 1 tablespoon 

Garlic - 2 tablespoons chopped finely

Tomato Ketchup - ¼ cup

Vinegar - 2 tablespoons 

Sugar - 2 tablespoons 

Soy Sauce - 2 tsp

Water - ¼ cup

 

Instructions

Mix all ingredients for meatballs. Heat oil in a pan. Add meatballs and fry till golden. Remove to a plate.

In the same Kadai. Add in oil and saute some garlic. 

Add in ketchup, soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, and water.

Bring it to a boil and cook till syrupy.

Now add in meatball and mix well.

Serve it.

 

Notes

1) You can add any spices or herbs in the meatballs. It is your choice.

2) The garlic in the sauce is what makes this so tasty. So add as much garlic as possible.

3) You can make this and store it in the fridge for up to a week.

4) Adding sesame seeds will make this more appealing and adds a nice crunch.

 

Nutrition Information

Serving size: 74 grams Calories: 150 Fat: 9g Saturated fat: 3g Carbohydrates: 2g Sodium: 500mg Protein: 13g

स्टिकी चिकन मीटबॉल रेसिपी मेरे पसंदीदा में से एक है। इसे पकाने में मुश्किल से कुछ मिनट लगते हैं। इस नुस्खा के बारे में अच्छी बात यह है कि आप मीटबॉल में जो भी मसाले और जड़ी-बूटियां चाहें, जोड़ सकते हैं। स्टिकी चिकन मीटबॉल रेसिपी आपके स्वाद के अनुसार अनुकूलित करना आसान है।

मीटबॉल को चटाने वाली चटनी मीठी और रसीली होती है। यदि आप कुछ किक चाहते हैं तो आप उनमें कुछ मिर्च फ्लेक्स जोड़ सकते हैं। लेकिन बच्चों के लिए बनाते समय, इससे बचना सबसे अच्छा है ताकि वे भी इसका आनंद ले सकें।

 

यहाँ सही, निविदा और रसदार चिकन मीटबॉल पाने के लिए कुछ सुझाव दिए गए हैं।

 

1) नमी जोड़ने के लिए कुछ दूध में भिगोए हुए ब्रेड डालें।

2) मीटबॉल को मिक्स न करें।

3) मीटबॉल को भूनें नहीं।

4) आप इसे रसदार बनाने के लिए मीटबॉल मिश्रण में थोड़ा पानी मिला सकते हैं।

5) अतिरिक्त नमी के लिए आधा चिकन स्तन और आधा चिकन जांघों को पीसें।

6) प्याज और मिर्च जोड़ने से मीटबॉल में नमी बढ़ जाएगी।

 

मुझे उम्मीद है कि आपको यह रेसिपी पसंद आएगी और अगर आप इसे आजमाते हैं तो मुझे बताएं।

स्टिकी चिकन मीटबॉल रेसिपी

 

तैयारी का समय: 10 मिनट

पकाने का समय: 30 मिनट

कुल समय: 40 मिनट

 

पकाने की विधि प्रकार: ऐपेटाइज़र

भोजन: चीनी

सर्व: 3 सर्विंग्स

 

सामग्री

मीटबॉल के लिए:

कीमा बनाया हुआ चिकन - 250 ग्राम

मिर्च पाउडर - ½ चम्मच

काली मिर्च पाउडर - ½ चम्मच

धनिया पत्ती - 2 बड़े चम्मच बारीक कटी हुई

हरी मिर्च - 1 चम्मच बारीक कटी हुई

परमेसन चीज़ - gr कप कद्दूकस किया हुआ

ब्रेड - 1 स्लाइस

दूध - 4 बड़े चम्मच

नमक स्वादअनुसार

इतालवी मसाला - 1 चम्मच

 

चटनी के लिए:

तेल - 1 बड़ा चम्मच

लहसुन - 2 बड़े चम्मच बारीक कटा हुआ

टमाटर केचप - - कप

सिरका - 2 बड़े चम्मच

चीनी - 2 बड़े चम्मच

सोया सॉस - 2 चम्मच

पानी - ¼ कप

 

अनुदेश

मीटबॉल के लिए सभी सामग्री मिलाएं। एक पैन में तेल गर्म करें। मीटबॉल जोड़ें और सुनहरा होने तक भूनें। एक प्लेट में निकालें।

उसी कदई में। तेल में डालें और कुछ लहसुन डालें।

केचप, सोया सॉस, सिरका, चीनी और पानी में जोड़ें।

इसे उबाल लें और सिरप तक पकाना।

अब मीटबॉल में डालें और अच्छी तरह मिलाएँ।

इसे दें या इसकी सेवा करें।

 

टिप्पणियाँ

1) आप मीटबॉल में किसी भी मसाले या जड़ी-बूटियों को जोड़ सकते हैं। ये तुम्हारी पसंद है।

2) सॉस में लहसुन है जो इसे इतना स्वादिष्ट बनाता है। इसलिए जितना संभव हो उतना लहसुन जोड़ें।

3) आप इसे बना सकते हैं और एक सप्ताह तक फ्रिज में स्टोर कर सकते हैं।

4) तिल के बीज जोड़ने से यह अधिक आकर्षक हो जाएगा और एक अच्छा क्रंच जोड़ता है।

 

पोषण जानकारी

सेवारत आकार: 74 ग्राम कैलोरी: 150 वसा: 9 ग्राम संतृप्त वसा: 3 जी कार्बोहाइड्रेट: 2 ग्राम सोडियम: 500 मिलीग्राम प्रोटीन: 13 ग्राम

related.title: Tasty Oven Roasted Chicken ( With Vegetables ) Recipe
related.title_hi: टेस्टी ओवेन रोस्टेड चिकन (सब्जियों के साथ) रेसिपी
related.content:
Delicious and very easy roast chicken with veggies tastes so yummy. It takes less than 10 mins to put together. Healthy chicken with veggies.

This is an easy dinner or lunch to put together. It takes less than 10 mins to put together. Once you assembled everything it takes around 40 to 45 mins to cook. The chicken is so flavourful and tastes so juicy. The chicken outside has a nice crust in them and the inside is so juicy.

 

Roast Chicken with Vegetables

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 45 mins

Total time: 55 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 5 servings

 

Ingredients

Chicken - 1 whole chicken, cut into 12 pieces

Oil - 3 tablespoons

Carrot - 2 chopped

Cauliflower - 2 cups

Onion - 1 chopped

Potato - 1 peeled and cubed

Garlic - 10 cloves with skins on

 

FOR SPICE MIX:

Red Chilli Flakes - 1 tablespoon

Chilli Powder or Paprika - 1 tablespoon

Salt - 1 tablespoon

Parsley - 2 tablespoons

Oregano - 1 tablespoon

Sumac - 2 tablespoons

 

Instructions

Preheat oven to 200 degrees C. Mix spice mix together and set aside.

Take veggies in a baking pan. Add spice mix and oil and toss well.

Place chicken over it and sprinkle with spice mix and oil and mix well.

Pop it in the oven and bake for 35 to 45 mins.

Remove and serve it.

related.title: Tasty Varutharacha Chicken Curry Recipe
related.content:
Delicious spicy chicken curry made using roasted spice masala and coconut masala which is so yummy with rice.

This chicken curry is made using roasted whole spices masala which tastes super delicious. The freshly roasted spices give so much flavor to the chicken curry and make it super yummy.

 

Varutharacha Chicken Curry Recipe

Prep time: 15 mins

Cook time: 45 mins

Total time: 1 hour

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 6 serving

 

Ingredients

Coconut Oil - ¼ cup

Fennel seeds / Sombu / Saunf - 2 teaspoons

Cumin Seeds / Jeerakam - 1 teaspoon

Bay Leaf - 1

Cardamom / Yelakai - 5

Cloves / Krambu - 5

Cinnamon / Pattai - 1 stick

Brinji Ilai / Pandan Leaf - 1

Chicken - 1 kg

Shallots - 30 peeled and chopped finely

Tomato - 4 to 5 chopped finely

Green Chillies - 2 slit

Ginger Garlic Paste - 2 tablespoons

Potato - 1 peeled and cubed

Salt to taste

Tomato - 1 chopped for adding last

Curry Leaves a handful for adding last

 

TO ROAST & GRIND:

Dry Red Chilli - 10 to 12

Coriander Leaves - 4 tablespoons

Cumin Seeds - 2 teaspoons

Black Pepper - 2 teaspoons

Curry leaves a handful

TO GRIND:

Coconut - 1 cup grated

Roasted Gram Dal / Pori Kadalai - 1 teaspoon

Fennel Seeds / Sombu / Saunf - 1 teaspoon

 

Instructions

Heat a pan, add whole spices to toast. Cook till golden. Take it in a blender and puree till smooth. Set aside.

Take coconut, gram dal, fennel and grind to a smooth paste.

Now heat oil in a pan, add in whole spices, onions and cook till golden.

Add in ginger garlic paste and saute till raw smell leaves.

Add in tomatoes and curry leaves and mix well.

Add in chicken and cook till 5 to 6 mins.

Add in roasted coconut masala and water. Mix well.

Add this in a pressure cooker and cook for 2 whistles.

Take it off the heat and open the cooker.

Add in potatoes and cook till it is done.

Add in coconut masala and simmer for 10 to 15 mins.

Take the curry off the heat and add in tomato and curry leaves.

Serve it.

related.title: Tasty Pepper Chicken ( Milagu )  Gravy Recipe
related.title_hi: टेस्टी काली मिर्च चिकन (मिलगु) ग्रेवी रेसिपी
related.content:
Spicy black pepper chicken gravy goes well with roti, rice or idli or dosa too. This spicy chicken curry tastes super delicious and very peppery.

I have shared a few varieties of pepper chicken and mutton recipes here. But I haven’t shared the pepper chicken gravy which we simply love. I make this all the time. So here it is. It is not at all hard to make, it is super easy to make and taste simply amazing.

 

Pepper Chicken Gravy Recipe

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 45 mins

Total time: 55 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 4 servings

 

Ingredients

Chicken - 500 grams

Coconut Oil - ¼ cup

Bay Leaf - 1

Onion - 2 large sliced thinly

Green Chilli - 2 slit

Ginger Garlic Paste - 2 tablespoons

Tomatoes - 2 large chopped finely

Turmeric Powder - 1 teaspoon

Chilli powder - 2 teaspoons

Garam Masala Powder - 2 teaspoons

Salt to taste

Coriander Leaves for garnishing

 

FOR ROASTING & GRINDING:

Oil - 1 tsp

Fennel Seeds / Saunf / Sombu - 1 tablespoon

Cinnamon / Pattai - 1 stick

Black Pepper - 1 tablespoon

Coriander Seeds - 2 tablespoons

Onion - 1 large chopped

 

Instructions

Pressure cook chicken with a little salt for 2 to 3 whistles. Set aside.

Heat little oil in a pot. Add in spices and toast them. Take it in a blender.

Add onions and cook till golden brown. Add it with the spices and grind till smooth. Set aside.

Heat oil in a pot, add in onions, chilies and bay leaf. Cook till golden.

Add in ginger garlic paste and cook till raw smell leaves.

Add in tomatoes and cook till mushy.

Add in the ground masala and mix well.

Add salt, turmeric powder, chili powder, and garam masala and cook till oil separates.

Now add in the chicken along with any cooking liquid.

Mix well and simmer till oil separates.

Add coriander leaves and mix well.

Serve it.

related.title: Tasty Cheesy Chicken Nuggets ( Kids Special ) Recipe
related.title_hi: टेस्टी चीज चिकन नगेट्स (किड्स स्पेशल) रेसिपी

Cheesy chicken nuggets will be your kid's new favorite snack. So delicious and these are pan-fried instead of deep frying so it is more healthy.

This is so easy to make, you can make a bunch of these and freeze them. So you can fry them whenever you need them. Many of my readers have been asking for toddler nuggets recipe. I made this for my little one and she loved it to the core.

 

Cheesy Chicken Nuggets Recipe

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 15 mins

Total time: 25 mins

 

Recipe type: Snacks

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 2 servings

 

Ingredients

Boneless Chicken Breast - 2 cut into strips

Oil for pan-frying

 

FOR CRISPY COATING:

Breadcrumbs - 1 cup

Cheese - ¼ cup grated

Dried Parsley - 1 teaspoon

Garlic Powder - 2 teaspoons

Salt to taste

Pepper to taste

 

FOR BATTER:

Cornflour - 2 tablespoons

All-Purpose Flour - 4 tablespoons

Salt to taste

Pepper to taste

 

Instructions

Mix all ingredients for crispy coating and set aside.

Take all ingredients for batter and mix well.

Take the chicken and dip in the batter, coat in breadcrumbs.

Now pan fry till golden brown on each side.

Serve with ketchup.
